notes.title: Game modes, rules, tips and strategies explained
notes.content:
Here are details of everything that you can play and how to do it properly.

[h1] Arcade[/h1]
There is plenty to play in Arcade mode.
-You can play alone or put all real/cpu players on same team to compete for high score and reach level 100. In this mode score matters the most and it is saved to local and global Leaderboards. Beside making high score and reaching level 100 you would also try to complete many of the achievements.
-If you play Arcade mode with multiple real/cpu players on different teams you will fight each other. There are many achievements that can be completed in this mode.
You can enable Fast Drop in Variants. With Fast Drop on you can instantly drop current blobs by pressing Up. There are many other things you can change in Variants like type of the garbage, number of colors and so on.
Note: by changing Variants you can disable achievmenets. For example if you start the game with 2 colors and reach level 100 you will not get any of the achievmeents you would if you started with 4 colors which is default.

[h1] Tournament[/h1]
Fight against all girls and hidden character at the end. After finishing Tournament you unravel your character's story and unlock last hidden character and stage that become available in other modes.
Finish Tournament to compete on local and global Leaderboards.
You can compete on Tournament leaderboard even if you use Continues but all play times will be summed. The faster you finish it the better you are placed on the leaderboard.
Other player can take control of the CPU any time by pressing Start on their controller. But in this case you will unlock nothing at the end.

[h1] Endless Battle[/h1]
Try to win as many consecutive battles as possible. Compete on the leaderboards with the number of wins. Complete achievements.
Up to 8 real/cpu players can play together.
Note: you need to play alone to compete on the leaderboards.

[h1] Puzzle[/h1]
Try to solve as much as possible of the 100 randomized puzzles grouped by difficulty. Puzzles are randomized from a pool of total 150 puzzles.
Puzzle mode can also be played with other real/cpu players.
Note: you can't complete Puzzle achievements if you play with cpu players.

[b]Playing with different RULES[/b]
-Beside DEFAULT rule where you stack blobs by color and clear the groups by adding 2 or more same color stars you can also play with completely different rules that require different way of thinking and different strategies.
Main focus with default rules is to create groups as big as possible and set up combo chains along the way. All game modes except for Puzzle mode can be played with any of the rules. Many of the achievements can't be completed when playing with other than default rules and also you can't compete on the leaderboards with it. But there are some achievements created for the non-default rules.
-MATCH 4: no stars or gems. You need to connect 4 or more blobs to clear a group. Main focus with this rules is setting up big combo chains.
-1 STAR: all blobs that fall are without stars. Stack the blobs by color. Only one star is required to clear a group. Stars can only be added to the current falling blobs by pressing Up. Main focus here is to stack the groups as big as possible and as fast as possible.

[b]Tip and tricks[/b]
-One of the biggest mistakes that new players make is that they try to clear color groups as fast as possible in order to keep clear board. THIS IS THE WORST STRATEGY! When you play like that you send very little garbage to the opponent/s when fighting and you also score least points when playing for high score.
In short, BEST STRATEGY would be to maintain one or more big color groups and clear other color groups as small and as fast as possible so you can maintain and grow the big ones. When you clear less than 4 color groups you are not releasing the pending garbage to fall on your board.
While you are building that one or two big color groups try to set up couple combo chains. Clearing big group/s with combo chains is the best thing you can do for sending a lot of garbage and scoring big points.
This is much easier said than done but with practice it becomes natural way of thinking and it makes huge difference.
-Have in mind that one random color always is dominant so try to figure it out and stack that one the most.
-When next blobs show up, there is tiny drop-delay window in which the blobs are not falling but you can make moves. Learn to utilize this in order to play much easier when the extreme speed ups kick in.
-Watch next blobs and decide where to place them before they even start falling.

Take a quick look at Monster Group achievement.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FU4dmpOY-do
I am planning to create more videos with detailed explanation for best strategies and tips.

Let me know what you would like to see explained in more details or what kind of video you would like to see.

Enjoy,
Endi

notes.title: Small update, ver 1.998
notes.content:
Hope you are all having great holiday time and wish you all the best in the upcoming year!

Small new update brings:
[list]
    [*]Now you can compete on Tournament Leaderboard even if you finish it with continues. Those that finish without continues will still have advantage since times from the matches you loose are added to the final score. Plus whenever you continue the points are reset but those are not so important since Tournament Leaderboard is ordered by fastest finish time.
    [*]Replay is now working on last stage in Tournament.
    [*]If you press Start on name input to go back to the menu without pressing OK to confirm the name, the name is automatically confirmed and the score is added to the appropriate local and global leaderboards. I have noticed that some players enter their name without selecting OK at the end and because of that they are not placed on the leaderboards.
    [*]Some minor tweaks.
[/list]
The game is now available on Xbox One store with free Trial and Play Anywhere!
https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/p/raining-blobs/9p8r3jmr87s9
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11444746/f80b1bca600f2db423c9d4583ea93b2da06e764f.png[/img]
Xbox One and Windows 10 versions support 8 Xbox controllers unlike the Steam version where you can have max 4 Xbox controllers and if you want more you need to add players on Keyboard or add non-Xbox controllers.
Xbox One version also supports keyboard.

Enjoy,
Endi

notes.title: New update - REPLAY!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11444746/6c21538d86aeee2d5f693b466861cf1a4f6c7db2.gif[/img]

New update brings ability to watch REPLAY of all ARCADE and TOURNAMENT games.
Also now you are able to look at the board stats for longer period between matches and continue when you want by pressing START or watch a REPLAY by pressing button A.
This works in both ARCADE and TOURNAMENT modes.

Replay is not available for ENDLESS BATTLE and PUZZLE modes.

In future updates I might add ability to save the replays, right now you can just watch them. You can watch them as many times as you want but once you continue they are gone.

Please give it a try and let me know if you find some issues.
The game had 0 bugs and 0 performance issues before this update so all these changes make me nervous before the Xbox One release :)

[i]NOTE: I am able to break REPLAY by abusing PAUSE/RESUME during regular plays and replays. I am working on this but if you are playing it normally you should be good.[/i]

I am planning to enter Xbox One certification very soon! 

Stay tuned and enjoy,
Endi

notes.title: Anniversary update! Ver 1.93
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11444746/f6ff0cb44f9d82fcc38891272c2f22eeade2cead.gif[/img]
A little over a year ago Raining Blobs was released on Steam! Over 25 updates changed and improved the game so much that I could release Raining Blobs 2 now :)

Update brings:
[olist]
    [*]Fixed Endless Battle bug that affected AI difficulty scaling when 2 or more players played together. For example if 2 players played together against 2 AI players, the first AI player would stay at the lowest difficulty and only second AI player would get harder as you beat it.
    [*]Since I got couple requests for removing girls from playing boards I added new option in Options - "Board Background" that let you remove the girls if you want to play on clear boards.
    [*]Nasty rare bug fixed when sending garbage after All Clear. You can look at this video and see that instead of just cancelling own garbage player in the middle also sends garbage to the opponents - https://youtu.be/L9CYE9mOwpc?t=387
    [*]Updated MonoGame framework library to latest version. Updates to the library are not visible in the game, just some internal improvements and bug fixes that were not affecting the game.
[/olist]

Lately I was busy with daily job and had to take a little break but don't worry, Android and Xbox One versions should be coming soon! ;)

Enjoy!
